features.name: Fernlea, Skene House
alternativeNames: SKENE HOUSE COTTAGE TO WEST OF STABLES BLOCK
features.shortDescription: SKENE HOUSE COTTAGE TO WEST OF STABLES BLOCK
features.fullDescription: Mid 18th century, ashlar. 2-storey, 2 window and centre door domestic W. part with single centre and corbels at 1st floor level for pentice. Skewputs W. gable. E. (coachhouse?) part piended with brick arched segmental doorway in gable end.

features.name: Walled Garden With Twin Gazebos, Skene House
features.fullDescription: 18th and 19th centuries. Partly stone lined with brick, W. wall wholly brick. Fine centre iron gate and twin ogee roofed gazebos at S. wall probably of 1847-50 period.

features.name: Terrace And Garden Ornaments, Garden, Skene House
alternativeNames: SKENE HOUSE, INCLUDING TERRACE AND GARDEN ORNAMENTS.
features.shortDescription: SKENE HOUSE, INCLUDING TERRACE AND GARDEN ORNAMENTS.
features.fullDescription: Archibald Simpson and William Ramage (?) 1847-50, in present form, large Scottish baronial mansion of 3/4 storeys in fall of ground remodelling of work of much earlier date. N. part originally a tower house (14th century?) with 3 vaults, entering at 1st; remodelled 1680 vaults gutted out and centre part added, both rubble-built. South wing added 1745 or earlier, ashlar. 1847-50:- S. wing extended, single-storey entrance hall and c inserted in court, old courtyard gate moved N, S. loggia and terrace added and fenestration remodelled throughout. Terrace has 2 dolphin fountains, sculptures of boar shepherd and dog, fine table sundial by J. Williamson Aberdeen 1736 and 2 flower pedestals (Coade stone?) consisting of 3 caryatids of late 18th century pattern.
